storyCards.headline: Can't Stop The Feeling: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Justin Timberlake's "Can't Stop The Feeling" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 52 weeks on the chart.

Can't Stop The Feeling was released in 2016.

"Can't Stop The Feeling" by Justin Timberlake.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
